name: multi-account-video-stats-web
description: Frontend dashboard (approach_12) for multi-account-video-stats: Next.js + TypeScript + TanStack Query. This directory (src/web) is the Next.js project root — pages/ is the Pages Router directory. No next.config file is required: Next runs on defaults, and it generates tsconfig.json on first dev/build if absent. The typecheck script below is intentionally tsconfig-independent (all compiler options are passed as CLI flags) so CI can typecheck from a bare checkout.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --esModuleInterop --forceConsistentCasingInFileNames --jsx preserve --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler --target es2022 --lib dom,dom.iterable,es2022 pages/DashboardAccounts.tsx
